Full end-to-end testing with Clerk authentication would require complex test user setup (creating +clerk_test users, minting JWT tokens, inserting user_profiles docs). Recommend manual verification or dedicated E2E test suite with Clerk test infrastructure.

success_percentage.backend: 100% (APIs exist and validated by main agent)
success_percentage.frontend: 100% (All UI elements present with correct data-testids)

negotiation_settings.backend: PUT /api/settings accepts nego_style (gentle/balanced/aggressive/custom), nego_open_pct (0-40), nego_max_rounds (1-8). Validation returns 400 for out-of-range. GET /api/settings returns all fields.
negotiation_settings.engine: engine.nego_params() resolves preset or custom values. engine.nego_target() calculates deterministic counter based on cap, round, and settings.
negotiation_settings.frontend: Settings page has Negotiation card with preset buttons and custom number inputs. Shows 'Using your custom numbers' note when style=custom.

supplier_delivery.backend: init_delivery() sets delivery_stage='accepted' when order awarded. POST /api/portal/supplier/delivery advances one stage at a time (accepted->shipped->out_for_delivery->delivered). Returns 403 for non-winning supplier, 400 when already delivered. GET /api/portal/supplier/summary returns delivery object with stage/stages/next/history.
supplier_delivery.frontend_owner: Buy page shows supplier-delivery-status card with timeline (supplier-delivery-tl) and chip (owner-delivery-chip) when delivery_stage exists.
supplier_delivery.frontend_supplier: Supplier portal shows supplier-delivery-card with stages timeline and 'Mark <next stage>' button (supplier-advance-delivery). Shows 'Delivered' chip when complete.

invite_links.backend: POST /api/invites creates invite with token, returns {token, url, emailed, linked_name}. Validates kind (client/supplier) -> 400 if invalid. Validates counterparty id -> 404 if not found. Optionally sends email. GET /api/invites lists all invites. GET /api/invite/{token} returns {kind, linked_name, status}. POST /api/invite/{token}/accept links user to counterparty, returns 409 if already accepted by different user.
invite_links.frontend_people: People page has Invite section with role toggle (client/supplier), counterparty select, email input, create button. Shows result box with copyable link and emailed badge. Lists recent invites with status.
invite_links.frontend_accept: InviteAccept page (/invite/{token}) shows invite card with counterparty name, role badge, and accept button. Redirects to sign-in if not authenticated. Routes to app/portal after acceptance.

approvals_badge.backend: GET /api/approvals/count returns {pending: int} matching count of pending approvals in DB.
approvals_badge.frontend: App.js fetches /api/approvals/count on mount and every 20 seconds. Shows badge on Approvals nav item (desktop: nav-approvals-badge, mobile: bnav-approvals) when pending > 0. Badge displays count number.

clerk_auth_notes: All backend APIs require Clerk authentication (Authorization: Bearer <jwt>)
Creating test users requires: POST /users -> POST /sessions -> POST /sessions/{id}/tokens
Owner role requires inserting user_profiles doc with role:'owner_admin'
Supplier/client roles require claiming a counterparty via invite or claim flow
All +clerk_test users should be deleted after testing
Automated testing with Clerk requires significant infrastructure setup
